name: @ultm8/school-portal
description: React — School Portal (Spec §4.2). Tenant-facing web app: School/Branch management, auth, and staff invitations built in Phase 3. As of Phase 14, apps/api has 14 more backend modules (Classes, Timetable, Instructors, Memberships, Transactions, Waivers, Ranks, Booking/Waitlist, Guardians, Attendance, Academies, Settings, Payments) with no corresponding UI here yet — the endpoints exist and are stable, the screens for them just haven't been built.
